slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬

第23章障眼法
林熙回过神，看着秦芬和小胡警官，道：“把他发生症状之前的事情和我详细说一下。”
两人没有迟疑，很快便将事情的来龙去脉跟林熙说了。
这事也简单，因为王警官是从那个巷子出来之后才“犯病”
的，所以他们一致认为这件事情肯定跟那条巷子，甚至跟那个嫌疑人有关，于是他们当天就去那巷子进行了调查。
可让他们所有人都惊讶的是，那处小院竟然已经人去楼空。
院子里，屋子里，全都空空如也，什么都没有留下，甚至还像许久没有住过人一般，仅剩灰尘。
一群人觉得奇怪，因为明明早上王警官才刚从那间屋子出来，没道理才过了几个小时人就逃了，还把痕迹都收拾干净了。
可他们再不相信，事实就摆在眼前，由不得他们不信。
“我也去看了两次，一直没有见到有人，问过了周边的邻居，他们却说没有听到任何动静。”
小胡警官眉头紧锁。
能这么悄无声息的把家给搬走，肯定不是那老头一个人做的，说不定他有同伙！
只可惜这几天任凭他们怎么追捕，都没有找到那老头的身影。
找不到他，不仅仅是几个月前的那桩女性失踪案没有进展，就连师父的病也找不到线索。
林熙闻言，忽然道：“有没有一种可能，他根本没有离开。”
啥？
没有离开？
可是他们确实没在那院子找到人啊，难不成他们这么多眼睛都看错了？
见小胡警官一脸疑惑，林熙道：“方便的话现在带我去那边看看吧。”
带她去当然是没问题的，只是…..

“林熙妹妹啊，那我师父这？”
林熙倒是差点忘了王警官，她一心惦记着去找那个下蛊的人了。
轻咳一声，她掏出怀里的那张折叠三角符，将安放在里面的那个鬼魂放了出来，对他道：“去把那只阴蛊给吞了吧。”
符里封印的那鬼就是前两天从吴斌那收回的鬼，之前她本来打算将他和街上那群鬼一块送去投胎，结果这鬼见识过现代生活的美妙之后，坚决不想去投胎。
他说他宁愿当一只孤魂野鬼游荡，但因为他之前险些将吴斌害死，林熙自然是不可能让他在外面游荡的，便继续将他封印在符纸内，也算是对他的惩罚。
这会莫名其妙被放出来，那鬼还一脸懵逼，然后便听到了林熙的吩咐。
他是鬼，自然能看见趴在王警官身上不断吸取他生气的阴蛊，顿时露出了嫌弃的表情。
可是他再嫌弃也不敢跟林熙叫板，而且这种阴邪之物，说起来还能对他的修为有所提升。
于是他只能忍着恶心上前将那阴蛊拎起来，然后闭着眼睛视死如归的放进了嘴里。
嘎嘣脆。
还别说，怪好吃的！
见他将阴蛊吃掉了，林熙便又将他收回了符纸里。
倒是旁边的秦芬和小胡警官看着林熙一系列自言自语的操作，小心脏怦怦直跳。
这该不会是在跟他们看不见的什么东西对话吧？
“好了，王警官身上的问题暂时解决了，秦阿姨一会你要是有时间的话，可以推他去楼下晒晒太阳。”
太阳乃至阳之物，可以驱散王警官身上残留的阴气。
第23章障眼法
“啊，啊，好，好的。”
content_en:
Chapter 23 Blindfold
Lin Xi came back to her senses, looked at Qin Fen and Officer Xiao Hu, and said, "Tell me in detail what happened before he developed symptoms."
The two of them did not hesitate and soon told Lin Xi the whole story.
This is also simple, because Officer Wang "fell ill" only after he came out of that alley.
, so they all agreed that the matter must be related to that alley and even the suspect, so they went to that alley to investigate that day.
But what surprised them all was that the small courtyard was already empty.
The yard and the house were all empty, nothing was left, it even looked like no one had lived there for a long time, only dust was left.
A group of people found it strange because Officer Wang had just come out of that room in the morning. It made no sense that he had escaped just a few hours later and cleaned up all traces.
But if they still don't believe it, the facts are right in front of them, and they can't help but believe it.
"I also went to see it twice, but I never saw anyone. I asked the neighbors around, but they said they didn't hear any movement."
Officer Xiao Hu frowned.
To be able to move the house so quietly, the old man must not have done it alone. Maybe he had an accomplice!
It's a pity that no matter how hard they hunted in the past few days, they couldn't find the old man.
He can't be found. Not only has there been no progress in the missing woman case a few months ago, but there are also no clues about the master's illness.
Hearing this, Lin Xi suddenly said: "Is there a possibility that he didn't leave at all?"
What?
Didn't leave?
But they really didn't find anyone in that yard. Could it be that all their eyes were wrong?
Seeing Officer Xiao Hu's confused look, Lin Xi said, "If it's convenient, take me there now to have a look."
Of course there's no problem taking her there, but...
"Sister Lin Xi, what about my master?"
Lin Xi almost forgot about Officer Wang. She was focused on finding the person who had poisoned him.
With a slight cough, she took out the folded triangle talisman in her arms, released the ghost inside, and said to him: "Go and swallow that Yin Gu."
The ghost sealed in the talisman was the ghost recovered from Wu Bin two days ago. She had originally planned to send him to reincarnation together with the ghosts on the street. However, after seeing the beauty of modern life, this ghost decided not to reincarnate.
He said that he would rather wander around as a lonely ghost, but since he almost killed Wu Bin before, Lin Xi naturally couldn't let him wander outside, so he continued to seal him in the talisman paper as a punishment for him.
This ghost was released inexplicably. The ghost was still confused, and then he heard Lin Xi's instructions.
He was a ghost, so he could naturally see the Yin Gu lying on Officer Wang's body constantly absorbing his anger, and he immediately showed an expression of disgust.
But no matter how disgusted he was, he didn't dare to challenge Lin Xi, and this evil thing could actually improve his cultivation.
So he could only endure the nausea and stepped forward to pick up the Yin Gu, then closed his eyes and put it into his mouth as if he was dead.
Crunchy.
Not to mention, it’s delicious!
Seeing that he had eaten the Yin Gu, Lin Xi took him back into the talisman paper.
On the other hand, police officers Qin Fen and Xiao Hu next to them watched Lin Xi's series of operations muttering to himself, and their hearts were beating fast.
Could this be a conversation with something they couldn't see?
"Okay, Officer Wang's problem has been solved for the time being. If Aunt Qin has time, you can push him downstairs to bask in the sun."
Things from the sun and even yang can dispel the remaining yin energy in Officer Wang's body.

"Ah, ah, okay, okay."
